title: A permission condition and its negation stay visible across a hard core boundary

gold_facts.statement: 只有值班工程师批准时才允许重启。未经批准不得重启；
但只读健康检查始终可用。

reference_proposals.content: 重启仅在值班工程师批准后允许；未经批准不得重启。只读健康检查始终可用。

semantic_review: The authored reference proposal preserves a condition and a negation. It is not executed and cannot grant tool permission; every candidate remains an unverified hypothesis.

title: Consuming an early part cannot erase the immutable remaining fragment inventory

semantic_review: This pure test proves a complete stable plan still contains the late source statement after an early part is consumed. It does not persist or certify the SQL fragment-completion ledger.

title: A later fragment patches one prior assertion while preserving its sibling fact

sources.content: 更正：入口端口改为8081，备份时间不变。

reference_proposals.reason: Apply the explicit correction only to the unique port assertion.

semantic_review: The old entry and its complete required source closure are explicitly supplied. The test does not claim automatic old-entry retrieval, cross-batch semantic merging or publication.

title: Host validity does not make a late imported older rule the current decision

sources.content: 10:48定案：每月超额前25单位免费，之后每50单位向上取整。备份仍每天02:00。
09:48旧规则：超额没有免费额度，每50单位向上取整。

entries.content: 每月超额前25单位免费，之后每50单位向上取整。备份仍每天02:00。

gold_facts.statement: 每月超额前25单位免费，之后每50单位向上取整。

reference_proposals.reason: The later imported statement describes an older rule; preserve the newer decision.

patch.old_text: 每月超额前25单位免费，之后每50单位向上取整。
patch.new_text: 超额没有免费额度，每50单位向上取整。

known_wrong_host_valid_proposals.reason: An intentionally wrong arrival-order interpretation used only to show the host validator's limits.

expected.wrong_record: 超额没有免费额度，每50单位向上取整。备份仍每天02:00。

semantic_review: The authored noop is semantically appropriate. A literal but wrong patch can still be host-valid; that explicit negative control remains unverified and requires human rejection, rather than pretending automatic temporal reasoning is implemented.

title: Changed source versions invalidate fragment identities and oversized plans do not return a successful prefix

sources.content: 记录必须完整分析后才能确认覆盖。

gold_facts.statement: 记录必须完整分析后才能确认覆盖。
末尾要求：不把未知结果当作零成本。

semantic_review: Pure plan failures return no prefix as a completed whole-source plan. Actual persisted retries, coverage and cost remain the responsibility of separately exercised SQL/provider integration.
